description: This file contains Leaflet plugin code for handling spiderfying of clustered markers, including animated and non-animated versions, within the Leaflet.markercluster plugin. It manages the positioning and animation of overlapping markers when zooming or clicking on clusters.

classes.name: L.MarkerCluster
classes.description: Class extension for handling spiderfying of marker clusters, including animated and non-animated behaviors.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterNonAnimated
classes.description: Class extension for non-animated spiderfying of marker clusters.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterGroup
classes.description: Class extension managing the overall spiderfying state within a marker cluster group.

methods.name: spiderfy
methods.description: Triggers the spiderfying of overlapping markers within a cluster.

methods.name: unspiderfy
methods.description: Reverts spiderfied markers back to their original positions.

methods.name: _animationSpiderfy
methods.description: Handles animated spiderfying of child markers.

methods.name: _animationUnspiderfy
methods.description: Handles animated unspiderfying of child markers.
